finding: The two idle worker labels reuse the idle node color #64747C and are rendered as 7.5-size text. Against the film's dark surfaces, that palette is below a 4.5:1 normal-text contrast target: 4.16:1 on the camera background #04070C, 3.61:1 on the habitat tile #101B21, and 3.05:1 on the WORLD root fill #152B31. The available 854x480 render also shows the small gray labels in the dense center label band, where the low luminance separation is difficult to resolve.
